description: require('cluster') and require('trace_events') load with Node 22.22.0's exports: cluster as the primary (isPrimary, settings, setupPrimary's 'setup' event and the --prof logfile, disconnect with no workers, the Worker class), trace_events' Tracing objects (enable/disable, inspect), getEnabledCategories as the agent's sorted set, the >10 enabled warning, the argument errors. Host Node writes its trace file to /tmp (hostArgv); jsh writes none.
